comments.author: Downtown-Spare-822
comments.body: It uses Houdini Engine as a bridge between the two platforms.  The agent interprets the top down blueprint images and prompts through vision-language model to infer layout, style, and spatial structure.  It configures Houdini Digital Assets (HDAs) to construct buildings, walls, and the environments. Asset aesthetics are determined by the available 3D asset library, searched via CLIP embeddings or predetermined assets based on the HDA.
